description: Negation and power canonicalize to `-` and `^` (RFC §5.4.7). The two input spellings of negation, unary `-` and the deprecated `neg` (esm-spec §4.2 "Deprecated ops"), canonicalize to the unary `-` node; a binary `-` with a literal zero minuend and a non-literal subtrahend stays binary, since `0 - x` and `-x` differ when x is +0.0 (see `zero_minuend`); a double negation in mixed spellings collapses; a negated float literal becomes the negative literal; the deprecated `pow` canonicalizes to `^`. The canonical form never contains `neg` or `pow`.
